title: TTL + LRU Cache Decorator
instructions: Implement the `ttl_cache(maxsize, ttl, clock)` decorator in `ttlcache.py`: an LRU cache whose entries also expire after `ttl` seconds, with `cache_info()` / `cache_clear()`, preserved metadata and thread safety. Use an injectable clock, and call the wrapped function outside the lock.

evidence.label: Counts hits and misses and reports them in cache_info()
Entries expire exactly at ttl seconds
Evicts the least recently used entry; a hit counts as a use
Keyword arguments are part of the key; unhashable arguments raise TypeError
Exceptions are not cached; metadata is preserved; cache_clear resets everything
Rejects maxsize < 1 and ttl <= 0 with ValueError
A hit does not refresh the ttl, and stale entries are not counted in currsize
A slow call for one key does not block another (function runs outside the lock)
Positional and keyword calls are distinct keys; cache_clear resets the counters
